_doc: MEDICO dating cabinet (#37, Wave E, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #43). S.M. Frank & Co's filter-pipe brand, created 1933 WITH the absorbent paper filter (patent 1,967,585). THE CLIFF = BRYLON 1966: any Brylon (briar-resin synthetic) Medico is 1966+. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Medico.json (Lopés + tobaccopipes.com history). S.M. Frank family ties: bought KAYWOODIE brands 1955 (our kaywoodie.json S.M. Frank era); Royal Demuth/WDC lineage (Feuerbach — same family as the Kaywoodie guide authors' sources).

history_anchors._doc: S.M. Frank & Co: Sam Frank selling pipes from 1900; with Ferdinand Feuerbach made Royal DeMuth + Hesson Guard Milano. 1933: MEDICO brand + the absorbent paper filter launched together (filter patents: Minton 1932 application, improved #1,967,585 filed 1933, granted 1934). 1955: S.M. Frank buys the KAYWOODIE brands (Medico continues unchanged). 1966: BRYLON developed (briar+resin synthetic) — some Medico lines move to Brylon to cut costs, briar lines continue. Also sold via Cadogan + Oppenheimer Pipe in England. Modern line split: briar = Silver Crest, Premier, Bold Rebel, Kensington, Windsor; Brylon = Lancer, Apollo, Standard, Varsity, Conqueror, Medalist, Cavalier, V.F.Q. All push-bit with filters. College 'class pipes' exist (e.g. UNC Alma Mater).
history_anchors.logo: Early pipes: '+' (medic's cross) mark. Later: M inside a shield. Switch year undocumented.

brand_marks.physical: M-in-shield stem logo (early = + sign). Filter push-bit construction throughout. Brylon pipes: molded synthetic look, heavier than briar. A 'Medico Crest Artisan' made in ITALY exists (undated).
